global.title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
global.summary: A Meta spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in the way Meta crawls the web.

global.summaryEn: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and spends more time in meetings, as its staff composition and type of work changed significantly over the past year.
